name: News to Farholde
summary: Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep awaits your report after your work with Sergeant Riftan. Your return will show whether the venture succeeded.

sections.title: A Report for Ashe
sections.body: Sergeant Riftan sends you back to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep with a report. He gives you Kilgar's head to take with you. Ashe says she had begun to doubt her judgment while you were away, but now praises your talents.

faq.answer: Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep is waiting for your report.
Sergeant Riftan gives you Kilgar's head to take to Ashe Amberhall.

faq.q: What does Ashe say when I return?
faq.answer: Ashe says she had begun to worry she misjudged your talents, then says you were right for the job.

faq.q: What does Ashe say about Riftan?
faq.answer: Ashe asks whether Riftan is still around and says she expected you two to get along.

attribution: In-game quest text: News to Farholde
